description: Defines type traits, typelists, and helper templates for type introspection within the Android project, including type list structures, index lookup, and type selection logic.

classes.name: TypeTraits
classes.description: Provides type introspection traits such as checking if a type is an integer, float, pointer, or arithmetic type, and selecting parameter types accordingly.

methods.name: IndexOf
methods.description: Template struct to find the index of a type within a typelist.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Template struct to select one of two types based on a boolean flag.
